entries.3987b44a636c2a2a: It has adopted the corporate philosophy "Refine technology, support industry, open up the future" and conducts its business with "Safety First" as its core. As a medium- to long-term goal, under the national strategy of domestic semiconductor production, it aims to contribute to the revival of the domestic semiconductor industry by undertaking semiconductor production plants from startup (initial) through operation (operations). To achieve this, it names the securing of talented personnel (engineers) as the first challenge and says it will advance engineer development through in-house training. Its priority issues are strengthening safety management; strengthening the stable-earnings base divisions through the expansion of Total Facility Management (ＴＦＭ) and semiconductor equipment maintenance; strengthening its organization and internal management systems; and thorough information management.
